title: The merge skips lane lint when the head's all-jobs-passed rollup is green, and decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job line 11 is rewritten in place
why: Owner answered a to the lint-skip question (item 799). Gain per the consultant: about 9 min per lane merge, no re-lint after each main merge-in. Lose: the lint's checks run only in CI at merge.
source: Owner 21:01 CST Nov 13, relayed by the consultant (triage did not see it); ruling own-lint-skip-green-rollup-a.
note: Triage 21:02 CST Nov 13: coordinator (21:01) added it to lane merge-tool-audit-fixes (session_013NEJL1k9L6aaoYwt9rkang), which also rewrites line 11 of the decision. The 9 min figure is the consultant's, unmeasured by triage. Red case first: a head with a green rollup skips lane lint; a head with no rollup, or a red one, still runs it.
